identity.name: The American Journal of Sports Medicine
identity.source_note: Live guide is blocked to automated fetch (SAGE Cloudflare). source_hash is the SHA-256 of the normalized RAW Internet Archive snapshot of the official guide (web.archive.org/web/20250603200859id_/https://journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/AJS, captured 2025-06-03) and is reproducible. Rules were encoded from this Internet Archive snapshot. Session C's freshness cron must use a headless fetch to re-verify the live page.

encoding_notes: Live SAGE guidelines page is Cloudflare-protected (curl + WebFetch + headless render all 403). Rules encoded from the Internet Archive snapshot dated 2025-06-03 of https://journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/AJS; source_hash is of the live Cloudflare challenge shell per the README recipe.
ISSN 0363-5465 is print; online ISSN is 1552-3365.
AJSM does not specify a manuscript font: font Times New Roman 12 is a placeholder default for a double-spaced manuscript, flagged for the author rather than taken from the guide.
page_size, margins, alignment, first_line_indent, per-level heading rules, and page-number position are not specified by the guide -> null.
The 6000-word cap 'includes abstract and references' and applies to manuscripts generally; case reports do not require an abstract (abstract_max_words null for case_report).
Reference cap of 60 applies to all types EXCEPT review articles (systematic_review/review left references_max null); encoded per-type in word_limits, so references.max_count is left null.
Figures + tables must not exceed '3 journal pages' (1 large = 2 medium = 4 small per page); this cannot be mapped to integer figures_max/tables_max -> null, tracked out-of-schema.

Figure resolution is tiered (line art 1200 dpi, color photos 600 dpi, b&w photos 300 dpi); min_dpi=300 encodes the lowest requirement. The guide does not enumerate specific raster formats -> formats [].

references.style 'ama' per 'AMA Manual of Style (11th ed)'; references are listed in ALPHABETICAL order and numbered accordingly, with superscript in-text numbers (order 'alphabetical', in_text 'superscript'). DOI is not required (PMID requested for Epub-ahead-of-print items) -> include_doi false.
ORCID is strongly encouraged but not required (orcid_required false). A cover letter is optional and required only when a paper has more than 5 authors (cover_letter_required false).

Blinding: an anonymized manuscript is required (remove author names, initials, institutions; state/country allowed but not cities/regions) with identifying info kept separate; double_blind and scrub_metadata are inferred from the mandated author-anonymized submission, not stated verbatim.

article_types mapped from AJSM 'study designs': meta-analysis + systematic review -> systematic_review; Current Concepts review articles -> review; case report, case series, and letters to the editor included. Technical notes and editorials are not offered as author-submittable types here -> omitted.
sections encoded only for original_research (guide prescribes IMRAD); case report/series and review section order is not prescribed -> omitted.

declarations: AJSM collects disclosures via the AJSM Author Disclosure Statement form and IRB approval as an in-text statement plus uploaded letter (not a manuscript declarations block). trial_registration (RCTs) and patient_consent (case reports / identifiable photos) are conditional.

Session-A consolidation (2026-07-09): supersedes any earlier note in this list that describes source_hash as a bot-challenge 'shell' hash or that records a placeholder body font/line-spacing. Authoritative current state: source_hash is reproducible per identity.source_note; font family/size and line-spacing are null wherever the live guide is silent, so the engine preserves the author's value rather than imposing a guess.

2026-07-25 Janine LIVE-GUIDE VERIFICATION (journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/ajs - the lowercase-slug URL resolved via WebFetch on 2026-07-25 where the uppercase /AJS path had been Cloudflare-blocked; worth retrying this form before declaring a SAGE journal unreachable). This file was Internet-Archive-sourced (2025-06-03 snapshot); it is now live-verified and AUDITS CLEAN with no corrections. Confirmed verbatim: "6000 words or fewer (including abstract and references)"; abstract "Background, Hypothesis/Purpose, Study Design, Methods, Results, Conclusion, Clinical Relevance" at "350 words or less"; "Index Medicus form for abbreviating journal titles and the AMA Manual of Style (11th ed)"; "References should be double-spaced in alphabetical order by the last name of the first author" (confirming the unusual order='alphabetical'); "Manuscript pages should be double-spaced"; the 60-reference limit; and the 3-journal-page combined figure/table cap already nulled in this file. CASE REPORTS AND CASE SERIES ARE ACCEPTED - the existing article_types are correct.

2026-07-25 Janine: references.et_al_threshold stays NULL - the live guide states no reference-list author-count rule (its "no more than 20 will be listed on the masthead" refers to the ARTICLE's own byline, not to citations). Null is correct per doctrine, BUT note the consequence: style='ama' falls through to STYLE_DEFAULT_ET_AL.ama, currently 6, while AMA 11th s3.7 truncates >6-author lists to the first THREE + et al. AJSM is therefore the highest-profile journal affected by the two-tier schema gap specced to Sushant on 2026-07-25. This file needs no change; the fix belongs in STYLE_DEFAULT_ET_AL.
